title: Creating a PlanetScale branch with service tokens

placeholders.quote: Make sure to fill in the `ORGANIZATION_NAME`, `DATABASE_NAME`, `BRANCH_NAME`, `PARENT_BRANCH_NAME`, `SERVICE_TOKEN_ID`, and `SERVICE_TOKEN` variables.

means: The service tokens page's cURL request, its variables filled in, with the create_branch access granted to the token, creates a branch from its parent and answers the branch it made, not ready yet.

title: pscale branch safe-migrations enable
means: "To enable safe migrations on a branch using the pscale CLI, use the following command in your terminal: pscale branch safe-migrations enable <DATABASE_NAME> <BRANCH_NAME>"

title: pscale branch safe-migrations disable
means: "To disable safe migrations on a branch using the pscale CLI, use the following command in your terminal: pscale branch safe-migrations disable <DATABASE_NAME> <BRANCH_NAME>"

title: pscale service-token create with a TTL
means: "You can also specify a time to live (TTL) in seconds using the --ttl flag. The token will be invalid once the TTL has passed: pscale service-token create --name \"My Token\" --ttl 3600. This command will return a service token ID, value, and expiration time (if TTL was specified)."

title: retention_unit hour
means: retention_unit accepts hour, day, week, month and year. The reference specifically gives retention_value 6 and retention_unit hour as six hours; the World clock is 2026-01-01T00:01Z.
